searchText: Hello! I am updating blob-utils to make it work with devnet-11 and I have a branch which can send transactions with blobs now. However the txs remain in the mempool without confirmation. Any idea anyone? ``` eth.getTransaction('0x46387e6754b4275ac940a0f9e309499bce097114a3dc91e2ca70beec8f3db687'); { accessList: [], blobVersionedHashes: ["0x018df59ea0e06856600198dbab80039388ca10e1ce150489c32ee19e319fd4e7"], blockHash: null, blockNumber: null, chainId: "0x1a1f0ff45", from: "0x760005deaae1c79146529dbb6eed12a7b15d015a", gas: 21000, gasPrice: 10000000000000, hash: "0x46387e6754b4275ac940a0f9e309499bce097114a3dc91e2ca70beec8f3db687", input: "0x", maxFeePerBlobGas: "0xb2d05e00", maxFeePerGas: 10000000000000, maxPriorityFeePerGas: 2000000000, nonce: 2, r: "0xfc0e4dd9e678b4fbc5085ce1ecda549cbf5ec8ac2f7b0c3dc29846c91717e06a", s: "0x5130b05134bfdffdc3a1b4907f43e18fefbb7fc2344ac7c77e3dd7783bd8e380", to: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", transactionIndex: null, type: "0x3", v: "0x1", value: 0, yParity: "0x1" } ``` Ok got it working! (the account I was using had already sent many txs that were unconfirmed due to low gas - using a new account solved it)

Hello! I am updating blob-utils to make it work with devnet-11 and I have a branch which can send transactions with blobs now. However the txs remain in the mempool without confirmation. Any idea anyone?

